invariant: A foreign Workspace discussion ID is rejected without locking the foreign row.
Parent deletion and discussion moderation cannot form a lock cycle; a vanished root rejects moderation.
Workspace deletion can cascade while a new annotation reply waits at the root.
Item deletion and an admitted Project-scoped Reply use the same ProjectItem-to-Annotation lock order, complete without a lock cycle and retire every Annotation and Reply identity.
A read projection tolerates Workspace roots deleted between READ COMMITTED queries.
Concurrent Item sections create one reading record without an integrity failure and retain the latest reading time.
Concurrent login failures atomically retain their count; a failure after a committed clear starts a new window, and expired cleanup cannot delete a newly reset window.

Login signing and credential reset/deactivation serialize at the User root; obsolete credential snapshots cannot sign after revocation or a competing rehash, and signing before revocation is removed. Each request verifies the password once without retry.
An admitted short write can finish before archive; a writer waiting behind archive rechecks lifecycle.
A discussion waiting behind Project archive rechecks lifecycle.
User status and authorization-sensitive mutations serialize without a User/Workspace lock cycle.
Administrative authority is rechecked after locking; cross-admin operations use stable User order.
Concurrent ownership transfers leave one authoritative Workspace owner and reauthorize the losing actor.
Only one current Workspace membership exists after concurrent rejoin attempts.

Project participation stays consistent with its mode and current Workspace membership; independent root guards remain shared; a selection removed before duplicate Join recovery reports a conflict without automatic reinsertion or a Join audit event.

Concurrent identical relation additions produce one association and count only new links; removal after a native conflict skip can win without recreating that link; unrelated constraint failures roll back every batch chunk.
Upload finalizers for different Items share the Workspace guard while exclusive governance waits; a finalizer rechecks authority after governance commits.
Annotation mutations recheck moderation and Project Item lineage after waiting.
Two Annotation or Reply edits using one expected version commit one version increment and one successful audit event.
An Item deletion racing bulk Project assignment produces a domain conflict rather than an integrity leak.
Two Item replacements using one expected version cannot both commit; the winner and search projection agree.
Concurrent confirmation and replay of one ImportBatch return the same Item IDs with one import audit effect.
Concurrent runtime-setting upserts persist the complete validated batch with its audit event and refresh loaded values.
Concurrent normalized Citation Style names produce one style and a domain conflict without invalidating the losing caller's transaction.
Concurrent shared Author identity batches recover their savepoint, preserve every missing identity and leave the caller transaction usable.
